subject: Notification: limited auth spike — IR plan request and evidence export
messages:
From: Alice Lawrence <alice.lawrence@finvault.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected auth activity — request for IR plan and evidence export

Hi Vivek —

We observed a short-lived but pronounced increase in 401/403 responses for a handful of our integration calls between 08:45 and 09:05 PST this morning. This affected three customer API keys (IDs redacted in-line) and caused a small number of failed billing events.

Can you confirm whether Redwood has an Incident Response Plan (IRP) we can reference, and whether you can provide a targeted evidence export for the timeframe below? Our procurement/security folks need items for our internal audit:

- Raw auth logs (10-second granularity) for 2026-12-10 08:30–09:15 PST
- SSO provider logs for the same window (token issuance/refresh)
- Any token revocation events and the initiating service account IDs
- A small sample of sanitized request IDs and headers for failed calls (for reproduction)

Attached a quick screenshot of our dashboard showing the spike (screenshot-authspike.png). We appreciate a short timeline and next steps by EOD.

Thanks,
Alice Lawrence
Sr. Sec Ops / FinVault
security@finvault.com

--
Attachment: screenshot-authspike.png (image/png)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Alice — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. We're taking this seriously.

Immediate plan:
1) I'll kick off a focused IR tasking and loop in Security (cc'd).
2) Marissa, Karthik: can you confirm availability to triage and prepare an evidence bundle for the 08:30–09:15 PST window? Priority items are the auth logs and token revocation events; a sanitized sample of failed request ids will help reproduce.
3) Alice: are the three affected API key IDs available to share over the secure drive link below? If not, we can accept them in an encrypted reply.

We will use the secure evidence handoff link: https://redwood-secure-drive/redwood/ir/requests/FV-2026-09 — please upload any specifics there. Expect an initial triage note within 2 hours and a preliminary evidence manifest by EOD.

Vivek Kulkarni

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:43:22 -0800
Subject: Triage summary and evidence deliverables (initial)

Vivek / team — quick triage update:

What we see so far (initial):
- Short elevated rate of 401s correlated with a misconfiguration in an internal LB retry policy that started at 08:44 PST and was reverted at ~09:02 PST.
- No indication of credential compromise; failures appear to be transient auth negotiation errors.
- Affected client keys: FV-uk-01, FV-us-17, FV-eu-05 (please confirm these are the three you saw).

Planned evidence package (for FinVault):
- Auth log extract (08:30–09:15 PST) — CSV, 10s granularity
- SSO token issuance/refresh logs — redacted for internal session ids
- Token revocation events list with initiating service account (if any) — redacted
- Sample sanitized request IDs and HTTP headers for 25 failed calls
- Short triage timeline (CSV) and a one-page summary for your audit team

Questions for FinVault:
- Do you require IP-level redaction or additional customer identifiers removed from headers?
- Any specific compliance format (SIG/CAIQ mapping) we should attach?

Attachments: ir_timeline.csv; redaction_guidance.pdf

I'll produce the evidence manifest within 3 hours and put artifacts on the secure drive (read-only link) with a short retention window for your team to download. If FinVault needs a notarized timeline for SOC 2 audit, flag that here and we'll route to Legal.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the quick triage. Confirming the three affected keys you listed are the ones we saw. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Redaction: please remove internal IP addresses and any payload-level PII. We need request headers + status codes and timestamps; header-level email addresses should be redacted.
- Compliance mapping: attach a short SIG/CAIQ crosswalk if you have one; it speeds internal review.
- Evidence access: can you provide the artifacts via a time-limited S3 link or a secure transfer. We prefer S3 presigned URLs.

We'd like a 30-minute handoff call this afternoon to walk through the artifacts. Are you available at 3pm PST?

Thanks,
Bob Lane
Sr. Compliance Manager
FinVault

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lawrence <alice.lawrence@finvault.com>, Bob Lane <bob.lane@finvault.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Postmortem and sanitized evidence bundle — auth spike on 2026-12-10

Team — thank you for the patience. Final artifacts are available in the secure handoff link and a short postmortem summary is below. Full bundle (sanitized) attached: sanitized-log-sample.gz; postmortem-20261210.pdf; sig_caiq_map.xlsx. Presigned S3 URLs were sent to FinVault via the secure drive.

Executive summary:
- Incident window: 2026-12-10 08:44–09:02 PST
- Impact: transient increase in 401/403 responses for three FinVault API keys (FV-uk-01, FV-us-17, FV-eu-05); no data exfiltration detected
- Root cause: an unintended change to an internal LB retry policy caused duplicated auth handshakes and intermittent token negotiation failures for certain short-lived sessions
- Mitigation: reverted LB change at 09:02 PST; deployed a hotfix to disable the aggressive retry path for impacted service tier
- Next steps:
  - We will share a sanitized auth log extract and SSO event list (done)
  - Update IR runbook to include LB retry-policy checks as part of pre-deploy validation (owner: Infra)
  - Quarterly tabletop to include this scenario for SIG/SOC 2 evidence readiness

Artifacts delivered:
- sanitized-log-sample.gz (sanitized subset of auth logs)
- postmortem-20261210.pdf (one-page summary + timeline)
- sig_caiq_map.xlsx (mapping of evidence to SIG/CAIQ questions)

If FinVault needs additional redaction or a notarized statement for SOC 2, please flag it here and we'll coordinate with Legal. Also attaching the HubSpot record for traceability: https://hubspot.redwood.company/deal/FV-2026-09

Call notes: Marissa, can you send the brief deck we used in the 3pm call to Legal for retention?

Thanks everyone —
Vivek
VP, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: sanitized-log-sample.gz (application/gzip); postmortem-20261210.pdf (application/pdf); sig_caiq_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
